name: Mathematics
tagline: Numbers don't lie. Neither will your solutions.
description: Master algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory with problems modeled directly on IMO and national Olympiad formats.

rounds.name: DMO — District Mathematical Olympiad
rounds.format: 50 MCQ · 100 min (2 min per question); score 25+ OR district Top 5 advances
rounds.marking: −0.25 per wrong answer (a blind guess is break-even)
rounds.eligibility: Regularly enrolled school/college students in Grades 8–12

rounds.name: PMO — Provincial Mathematical Olympiad
rounds.format: 35 MCQ + 5 numerical-answer questions; Top 10–15 per province advance
rounds.marking: Complete rigorous proofs required; correct numerical answers without justified reasoning receive minimal marks

rounds.name: NMO — National Mathematical Olympiad
rounds.format: 2 days × 3 problems × 4.5 h · 6 proof problems · 42 points · strict IMO format; Top 20 win national medals + camp admission
rounds.eligibility: PMO qualifiers from all 7 provinces + reigning national medalists

rounds.name: TST & Residential IMO Training Camp
rounds.format: 4-week residential camp (IMO alumni + university faculty) followed by 3 TST simulation exams; Top 6 cumulative scorers form the IMO delegation

rounds.name: IMO
rounds.eligibility: Under 20 on competition day; not enrolled at university

contacts.role: National organiser — DMO/PMO/NMO/TST; selects all international teams
